data.sqlSelect: select bd.sector_block_id, bd.geom, bd.srs, bd.short_descr, s.sector from lpis_sector_block_details bd inner join lpis_sector_blocks sb on sb.id = bd.sector_block_id inner join lpis_sectors s on s.id = sb.sector_id and s.tenant_id = sb.tenant_id inner join lpis_sector_areas sa on sa.sector_id = sb.sector_id and sa.tenant_id = sb.tenant_id inner join lpis_areas_hierarchies a on a.area_id = sa.area_id and a.tenant_id = sa.tenant_id where §current_timestamp§ between bd.dt_insert and bd.dt_delete and §current_timestamp§ between sa.dt_insert and sa.dt_delete and §current_timestamp§ between a.dt_insert and a.dt_delete and :reference_date between sa.day_from and sa.day_to and :reference_date between a.day_from and a.day_to and s.tenant_id={tenant} and bd.srs = 'EPSG:3003' and {spatial_where_clause}
